name: OmarCraft
author: Entangled-Forge
description: Productivity tools from the Omarchy bar: the ArtCraft Craft apps (PhotoCraft, FilmCraft, WordCraft and ten more), Typesetter, KolourPaint, Memospot and Vikunja. See what is installed, launch, install one tool or a group, update, remove. Prebuilt packages only (AUR -bin or the Arch repos), through Omarchy's own package commands. Unofficial.

barWidget.description: Craft apps and more: installed, available, updates. Left = panel, right = check the AUR, middle = switch layout.
